_note: S&L's own Instagram reels, re-encoded 540x960 H.264 with audio stripped (they play muted). Titles say only what is visibly in the clip. To add one: drop the MP4 and a poster JPG in public/reels/ and add a row. Clips are shown whole (object-fit: contain), so a clip that is not exactly 9:16 gets a thin graphite edge rather than a crop. Set "audio": true on a clip that keeps its soundtrack; the player then shows a sound button (clips start muted, the visitor unmutes).
